Title: Kubernetes integration with Azure Pipelines is now available

Body.Content:
You can now use GitHub identity to login into the Azure DevOps portal. In addition, you can take your GitHub repo all the way to Kubernetes using a YAML based multistage pipeline.

Check out the features list below for more.

General:

  • Signing into Azure DevOps using your GitHub credentials

Azure Pipelines:

  • Kubernetes integration for Azure Pipelines
  • Multi-stage YAML pipelines

Azure Artifacts:

  • Pay-per-GB
  • General availability of Python and Universal Packages

Administration:

  • A simpler way to buy Azure DevOps
